curriculum_section: Major > Upper Division Major Electives > A. Computer Systems

Supervised methods: convolutional neural networks, feedforward neural networks, linear regression, logistic regression, support vector machine; unsupervised methods: dimensionality reduction, k-means clustering, subspace learning. Applications in classification, regression and visualization.
prerequisites: CS 210 and MATH 254.
curriculum_section: Major > Upper Division Major Electives > B. Intelligent Systems

curriculum_section: Major > Upper Division Major Electives > B. Intelligent Systems
